comments.author: oblak
comments.body: The green one is MA, made in colony at NPC named Haru

comments.author: Tammer
comments.body:
For the recipe with Haru, the ingredients are as listed for the Japanese sewing book.

To recruit Haru to your colony, you do the immigration quest "Quiet Pharmacist" from Calicut to deliver 20 Noni to Sakai.

part of the memorial album Immigration Attraction (No.2).
